title: React Page Contract
description: Structural requirements for all compiled React page components

rules.title: Layout Integration
rules.description: Page must use the declared layout component — pages must not define their own nav/header/footer inline

rules.title: No Raw Fetch in Component Body
rules.description: Data fetching must go through compiled hooks (useXxx) — no raw fetch()/axios() calls in the page component body or useEffect

rules.title: Auth Guard
rules.description: If spec.auth !== 'none', page must redirect or render an auth guard before showing protected content

rules.title: No Inline Styles
rules.description: No style={{ }} props — use className with Tailwind/CSS modules/styled-components instead

rules.title: Loading Skeleton Not Spinner-Only
rules.description: Loading state should use a skeleton that matches the page layout, not just a centered spinner

rules.title: Error Recovery Action
rules.description: Error state must provide a recovery action — at minimum a Retry button or a link back to a safe route

rules.title: Consistent Loading Pattern
rules.description: Page must use either Suspense boundaries consistently OR explicit isLoading state — not a mix of both in the same render tree
